name: Ten bits against nine
result: The autopilot's seeds 1-12 from fresh data folders: the same run log (66 battles) and the same pictures at frames 5000, 10000 and 14990; the differential: every spec its nine-bit verdict, 246 of 246 mutations caught; chip 600 (Cannon's alias) dealt, fired, saved and continued.
meaning: Ten-bit chip ids change nothing for ids under 512, and an id past 511 plays in battle.
